summary: A picture or media clip names bytes the slide file does not hold, so it shows nothing.
A picture's bytes are not a format the slide can show, so it draws nothing.
Text does not fit its box, so it spills over the box's edge.
A shape's effects are too large to draw, so it is shown without them.
A run's font is not available here, so its text is drawn with a substitute and may wrap differently.
A shape lies entirely outside the slide, so the show never displays it.
A placeholder holds no text: the editor shows its prompt and the show shows nothing.
A picture has no alt text for screen readers.
